description: Three explorers encounter an isolated society organised entirely by women.

longDescription: This complete historical edition offers room to follow the author’s voice, setting and central concerns at their original pace. Character, social circumstance and the choices people make are part of its enduring appeal. The source edition retains its period language and introductory material; explore the credited source for publication and edition details.

authorInfo.bio: Charlotte Perkins Gilman was an American writer and social critic concerned with women’s independence and the conditions shaping everyday life. The Yellow Wallpaper draws on her experience of a prescribed rest cure. Her other works include Women and Economics and the utopian novel Herland.
authorInfo.edition: A complete short story, so its PDF is naturally shorter than a novel. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.
